apps.one_liner: Paste two URLs and see whether a browser treats them as same-origin, same-site or cross-site, with the Public Suffix List rule behind it (matching checked against the Python tld package on 120,000 hostnames).

apps.name: ParenWhy
apps.subject: developer tool: operator precedence across C, JavaScript, Python and SQLite
apps.one_liner: Type an expression and see how C, JavaScript, Python and SQLite each group it with parentheses and what value each gives (checked against gcc, Node, Python and SQLite on 120,000 generated expressions).

apps.name: PrintfWhy
apps.subject: developer tool: C printf format strings, flags, width, precision, length modifiers
apps.one_liner: Type a C printf format and arguments and see exactly what it prints and what each flag, width and precision did (checked against gcc and glibc on 34,318 generated formats).

apps.name: FindWhy
apps.subject: Unix find expression precedence
apps.one_liner: Type a GNU find expression and see how it is grouped, what it prints, and why each path was or was not printed.

apps.name: SortWhy
apps.subject: Sorting order: UTF-16 vs code points vs ASCII case folding
apps.one_liner: Paste a list and see it sorted four real ways, which items move between them, and the character that decided each step.

apps.name: FieldWhy
apps.subject: awk field splitting (FS, NF, $0 rebuild)
apps.one_liner: Enter a line and an awk FS; see how it is split into fields and what assigning to a field or NF does to $0.
